from_quote: The most plausible of these, who has appeared in print, has even deigned to admit that the election of the President is pretty well guarded.
rationale: The paragraph's note [1] names the Federal Farmer ("Vide Federal Farmer.") for an opponent's admission that the President's election is well guarded; the passage of the Federal Farmer's letters that says so is this one, in the third letter.
to_quote: The election of this officer, as well as of the president of the United States seems to be properly secured
